messages:
Aisha: Quick Q for managers — we have a few incoming title + comp changes this week. Need to confirm effective dates, backpay proration, and who signs off on manager evidence. If you’re on a case, reply with: employee name / new level / effective date / manager sign-off (Y/N) / any backpay needed. I’ll compile and loop in payroll. Thx!
Marco: Got it — Lina Chen / IC4 / eff 2026-04-01 / manager sign-off: yes. Backpay: likely none (paid through Mar). I’ll confirm PR.
Priya: Manu R. / L5 / eff 2026-03-15 / manager sign-off: yes. Needs retro 3/15 -> 3/31 proration.
Jason: @Aisha quick question — for external hires where offer letter has a future comp eff date, do we honor the offer effective date or the onboarding/payroll start? Example: Gabe start 2026-03-29 but offer says comp eff 2026-04-01.
Aisha: Unless otherwise noted, follow the offer effective date. If ambiguous, tag me and include the signed offer PDF.
Nora: FYI — payroll needs payroll codes for any retro payments. Please send a CSV with columns: employee_email, gross_retro_amount, payroll_code, reason. I’ll process on Tue cycle.
Sam: Note for managers: include the manager evidence link (one-sentence summary + link). Saves back-and-forth. :slightly_smiling_face:
Elena: For backpay calculation use: (new_annual - old_annual)/365 * number_of_days. Example: 
```csv
old_annual,new_annual,days,retro
120000,132000,17,(132000-120000)/365*17
```
Payroll-bot: :robot_face: payroll-bot reminder — payroll submission cutoff is 2026-03-30 17:00 PT for the April cycle.
Marco: Added Lina to the shared sheet -> no retro.
Priya: Manu retro calc done, small amount. @Nora sending CSV now.
Jason: Gabe case: offer eff 4/1, will honor and I’ll upload signed offer to folder.
Aisha: Thanks — I’ll consolidate and submit to @Nora by EOD today. If anything needs exec approval (exceptions >20% comp change) please flag it now.
Nora: Exception process note — >20% increase requires manager justification + VP approval. Put 'exception' in the reason column so it routes correctly.
Priya: Manu is ~22% bump — looping in VP @Elena and adding justification to the doc.
Elena: I’ll review the justification. Quick note: for >20% we usually do a single gross retro payment rather than spreading out.
Aisha: Final ask — managers, confirm uploads of any signed docs into the hiring folder: /hr/comp_changes/2026-MAR. If you don't have access DM me and I’ll grant.
Marco: Done (uploaded).
Priya: Done (uploaded + CSV sent).
Jason: Done (offer uploaded).
Aisha: Closing thread after I submit. :white_check_mark:
